_source: PR 3c exact strings: home-region-step1.md §H (HR-S1–S16), mock-v2-notes.md (V2-1…V2-9, V2-43…V2-47), pr3-step1.md §E.5, and the PR 3c brief (scan_started false variant; S35 n = 0). Placeholders: R, H, A (account), S/E (period), N (new), O (old). Founder decisions Nov 17: c (no "· —"), f (keepFailed), L-7 (the split buttons wait for a running scan with the proposal's HR-S5 hint).

proposal.title: Your AWS costs point to R as your home region.
proposal.bodyFlagOff: 84% of this account's regional AWS spend in the last 30 days was in R; H (your home region now) had 3%. Your home region is where DevControl checks cost savings, Operational Health and Security Hub, and the one region it scans for resources (S3 and CloudFront are checked everywhere).
proposal.bodyFlagOn: 84% of this account's regional AWS spend in the last 30 days was in R; H (your home region now) had 3%. Your home region is where DevControl checks cost savings, Operational Health and Security Hub.
proposal.footnote: Based on AWS Cost Explorer usage charges for account A, S – E. Credits, refunds and tax aren't included. You can change your home region at any time on the Services page.
proposal.scanRunning: You can switch when the current scan finishes.
proposal.member: Only an organization owner can change the home region.
